question.problem:
Maggy is building a pyramid from a cardboard net, shown below.  What will be the total surface area of the pyramid?  

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14249141/assets/29c918514e60da13363883770befd9d80098deaba0b45cfcafa3255feb143261.png)
question.worked_solution:
The net shown corresponds to a triangular pyramid. The surface area of our pyramid consists of $1$ triangular base and $3$ triangular sides.

Adding the areas, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Surface area} & =1\times (\text{Area of base})+3\times (\text{Area of side}) \\  & =1\times 10+3\times 12 \\  & =10+36 \\  & =46\,{\text{in}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
